name: Explainability Dashboard UI
implementation_summary: Implemented the Explainability Dashboard UI in the frontend. Created ExplainabilityPanel, ContributionList, and EvidenceSection components to render the Phase 6.2 /predict response visually. The dashboard correctly displays positive/negative model contributors, URL evidence, website evidence, threat intelligence, and handles unavailable RT features accurately.
known_limitations: UI scale behavior depends strictly on the maximum contribution provided in the backend list to normalize widths; it does not change the actual values.
